changelog:
v1.10.8 Android Native Push Notifications & Form Management:
• Fixed Android FCM push notifications delivery: resolved server-side CSRF token blocking on token registration
• Registered High-Importance notification channels on application startup with custom sound, lights, and vibration
• Added valid status bar notification icon (ic_stat_notification) and FCM manifest metadata
• Updated FCM payload data normalization and channel ID alignment (echowithin_notifications)
• Form owners can now edit questions, options, settings, and form types with inline management
• Added instant push and in-app notifications when shared notes are updated
